classification.difficultyReason: Each of four parts needs the interior angle at the other crossing on the opposite side of the transversal. The orientations are horizontal, vertical, shallow and steep. Parallel marks and the labelled angle are supplied, so this is the same recognise-and-draw task as the co-interior question p48-q4.

content.prompt: Draw an arc showing the angle alternate to $p$.

answer.short: Arc above the lower parallel, between its west arm and the transversal's upward arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $p$ (alternate angles).

answer.short: Arc left of the right vertical and above the transversal.
answer.worked: The marked angle is between the vertical parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $p$ (alternate angles).

answer.short: Arc above the lower parallel, between its east arm and the transversal's upward arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $p$ (alternate angles).

answer.short: Arc above the horizontal, between the right parallel's upward arm and its west arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the horizontal transversal from $p$ (alternate angles).
